description: Send one server-side conversion (lead, signup, purchase, subscribe...) to server-track-lab, which normalizes, SHA-256 hashes and dedupes it, then forwards it: Meta Conversions API live (with the workspace's own pixel/token), Google Data Manager API validate-only preview (nothing recorded), LinkedIn dry-run (not sent). Reuse the same event_id on retries; duplicates are free and not re-sent. Counts as billed usage (first 1,000/month free, then CA$2 per 1,000).

event_id.description: Stable unique id for this conversion (also used by Meta for Pixel dedup)

event_name.description: e.g. lead, sign_up, purchase, subscribe, demo_booked

user.description: At least one identifier (email, phone, external_id, fbp/fbc, gclid...)

name: track_event
title: Send a conversion event
